title: ComparisonTable
description: Component used to compare what several plans include, feature by feature

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: The plans that are compared, one per column

price.title: Price
price.description: Price of the plan, e.g. "$99" or "On request"

pricePeriod.title: Price period
pricePeriod.description: The period the price refers to, e.g. "Per month". Leave empty for a one-off price

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Optional badge above the plan name, e.g. "Popular". Leave empty for no badge

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.description: Present this plan as the recommended one, on an inverted column

cta.title: Call to action
cta.description: The button that starts this plan

label.title: Label
label.description: Text content to display inside the button

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to link to when the button is clicked

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Variant of the button. Defaults to `primary` on a highlighted plan and `tertiary` on a regular one

featureRow.title: Feature rows
featureRow.description: The features that are compared, one per row

label.title: Label
label.description: Name of the feature this row compares

value.title: Values
value.description: One entry per plan, in the same order as `plans`. A `text` for a comparable value, an `icon` for included or not included, neither for an empty cell

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: An icon instead of text, e.g. "check" for included or "close" for not included
